summary.headline: Rhetorius Codices and Zodiac Proem
summary.text: Discussion of codices r and s preserving chapters of Rhetorius, including manuscript readings, chapter contents, and the editor’s plan to distinguish Porphyry’s text from Rhetorius’s. The opening proem asks why the zodiac begins with Aries rather than Cancer, the cosmic horoscope, or Leo, the solar zodiac sign.
